Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI), evidenced by significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and >100,000 CFU/mL Citrobacter freundii. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are also noted. The low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts were detected, suggesting no upper tract involvement. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
